replacements.old: Wild becomes available while the power is zapped.
replacements.new: Only Wild is available for an otherwise legal play while the power is zapped. Zapping the enabled power does not undo the already-played flare or permit a second play of it in the same encounter; the ordinary per-player and per-flare limits still apply.

replacements.old: “Sent” ships can be lost through a separate effect, including voluntary sends, without being encounter-losing ships.
replacements.new: “Sent” ships reach the warp through a specific action or effect, sometimes voluntarily, while not directly involved in the encounter; they count as lost rather than encounter-losing ships.

replacements.old: With Mobius Tubes and no colony to receive released ships,
replacements.new: Ships landing on colonies do so simultaneously, including ships released by Mobius Tubes (FAQ p19, general landing rule). With Mobius Tubes and no colony to receive released ships,

replacements.old: Reserve Wild need only be played once in the encounter, then can take eligible reinforcement discards for its remainder.
replacements.new: Reserve Wild need only be played once in the encounter. For the remainder of that encounter, whenever another player discards a reinforcement, its user may take that card into their own hand; this does not retrieve their own discards.
